svg.title: Position, velocity and acceleration of the jet car as it reaches top speed
svg.desc: (a) Position rises almost linearly from 2.9 km to about 19.2 km over 70 s. (b) Velocity rises from 165 m/s and levels off at 250 m/s; a tangent at 25 s runs from 210 m/s at 1 s to 260 m/s at 51 s, a slope of 1.0 m/s². (c) Acceleration falls from 5.0 m/s² to zero.
